networks.name: creator_agent_studio
networks.description: Give me a topic. My agents write the brief, a YouTube script, an X thread and a storyboard, right onto this page.
sample_queries: Make a 3-minute video and a 5-post X thread about why sleep matters for students.
Write everything in Simplified Chinese about cheap weekend trips around Chengdu, with a calm tone.
Shorten the X thread to 4 posts and make the hook punchier.
Open the first post of my thread in X so I can post it.
Upload the finished video to my YouTube channel.

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions, plus the partner sites in allowed_peers, which this site calls only after the visitor agrees on a card.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
